project_type: React 18 + TypeScript + Vite portfolio website with Tailwind CSS and Framer Motion
build_system: Vite with TypeScript compilation (tsc + vite build)
test_framework: No test framework configured - validation via build only
test_command: npm run build (no separate test command)
verification_instructions: Run npm run build to ensure TypeScript compiles and Vite bundles successfully
snapshot_or_generated_files: dist/ directory is generated but gitignored
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access. Node.js 22 available. npm available.
contribution_requirements: Push to origin/main triggers GitHub Pages deployment via .github/workflows/deploy.yml
key_patterns: Components use darkMode prop, framer-motion for animations, useReducedMotion hook for accessibility. Data arrays at top of component files. Icons from react-icons (fi, hi, si, vsc, bs prefixes).
relevant_files: src/components/About.tsx - professional summary and quick stats
src/components/Projects.tsx - featured projects with GitHub links
directory_structure: src/components/ has all section components. src/hooks/ has useReducedMotion. public/ has resume PDF and photo. .github/workflows/ has deploy.yml.
